configuration.summary: No OpenStack configuration was applied because the workspace host failed the disposable-lab safety gate.

first_success.summary: No Nova or libvirt connection was attempted.

first_failure.summary: The discovery preflight rejected the non-disposable host before any OpenStack operation; this is not the OSD-001 Nova blocker.

libvirt_api_or_xml.summary: No libvirt API call or generated domain XML was observed; source inspection confirms that libvirt has a distinct stateful Cloud Hypervisor driver.

qemu_specific_assumptions.summary: Nova constrains libvirt virtualization type to kvm, lxc, qemu, or parallels and defaults other configured types to the QEMU system URI unless connection_uri is overridden.

network_expectation.summary: No Neutron behavior was tested. A later isolated probe must record VIF XML and tap ownership independently from VM lifecycle.

storage_expectation.summary: No Cinder behavior was tested. A later isolated probe must record block mapping independently and only after the basic compute result.

core_authority_impact.summary: The inspected libvirt ch driver is a state driver that starts and monitors Cloud Hypervisor, which would create a lifecycle authority outside chv-agent and violate ADR-016.

generic_upstream_option.summary: Generic Nova backend capability work does not resolve libvirt process authority; no bounded upstream patch is justified by this partial evidence.

maintained_components: Nova ComputeDriver compatibility adapter outside CellHV Core

basis.summary: The source audit maps host reporting, lifecycle, image, Neutron, Cinder, console, retry, restart, and explicit unsupported behavior.

security_risk.summary: Using libvirt as a second process authority violates the Core authority boundary; running DevStack on this shared host could mutate unrelated network resources.

maintenance_risk.summary: Nova's distributed QEMU/KVM assumptions make generic libvirt backend expansion a broad, high-test-burden change.

recommended_next_step.rationale: Run the pinned Path A connection probe on a dedicated disposable host to capture the exact first Nova/libvirt blocker; do not begin Phase B before review of that evidence.
rejected_alternatives: Run DevStack on the shared workspace host
Treat source inspection as T5 evidence
Select a production OpenStack integration before OSD-001
residual_risks: The exact first Nova/libvirt runtime blocker is unknown
Neutron and Cinder behavior remains untested
No T5 acceptance scenario has passed

cleanup: No lab resources were created because preflight failed before mutation
The workspace host was left unchanged
